output:
To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Renee,

Here’s the football rundown for Monday’s admin meeting and Dr. Pruitt’s board report. Been a week, so I’ll keep it tight.

Friday night: Vulcan Ridge 31, Brookhollow 14. That locks up second in the region. Tavion Hurst had 188 yards and 2 TDs; his long one in the third was behind the best blocking I’ve seen from our line all year—they pushed them about 5 yards back on that whole drive. The kids also voted Deshawn Pettaway defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches even met. He had 3 sacks and 7 tackles.

Playoffs: AHSAA brackets are out. We host Clanton Valley in the first round Friday, Nov. 13, at 7 p.m. at Ridge Field. Presale starts Tuesday. I need gate and chain crews confirmed by Wednesday, and the boosters need six more people on concessions. Please make sure Dr. Pruitt knows it’s a home playoff game and folks should come out.

Grades: nine-week grade check is clean. All 52 kids on the roster are eligible, nobody on the list. That’s Tonya Greer’s doing—her Tuesday/Thursday study hall is the reason, and she should get the credit, not me. She’s keeping it going through the playoffs.

Boosters: Boston butt sale final was 208 butts sold, $6,240 raised against a $4,500 goal. Money goes to the new sideline headsets. Hargrove’s Meat Market smoked them at cost.

Bus note: if we win and go on the road, I’ll get you the transportation request. I know it’s due five days out for playoff away games.

Thanks,
Coach
